title: fix(objectql): a package registered again lists its navigation contributions once, not once more per registration
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgQztMGCF63EykeFKi27sXAd)_
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：包体注册时，它往别的应用里加的导航项（`navigationContributions`）改为按包整体替换，不再每注册一次就追加一份；卸载包时一并清掉。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 停用再启用模块后，所有模块的菜单都出现两次，重启才好。实测停用/启用本身并不重复，翻倍来自包体被重新注册（`os dev` 重编产物触发的重载会把产物里每个包都重注册一次），每次重载多一份，正好是「一个模块操作，所有模块都重复」。
- 风险与回滚：只影响导航项的登记方式；替换在原位进行，顺序与首次启动完全一致；逐条追加的旧方法 `registerAppNavContribution` 不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `setPackageNavContributions`；`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 导航折叠那段（约 L2402）；`registry-nav-contributions.test.ts` 末尾新增的 #30581 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/registry-nav-contributions.test.ts`，预期 13 个全绿，其中 #30581 下 7 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30581

Clause-②: no — the served app navigation returns to what a fresh boot serves; nothing a caller sends is refused
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

**The card's mechanism, measured and corrected.** On the real kernel (`MetadataPlugin` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `AppPlugin`, `PATCH /packages/:id/disable|enable` through `HttpDispatcher`, `origin/main` 6701c08a; the 18.3.0 enable door is the same code), an app plus two modules (`orders` into `g_sales`, `service` into `g_service`):

| step | served `GET /meta/app` navigation | registered contributions |
|---|---|---|
| boot | `g_sales[accounts,orders] g_service[cases]` | 2 |
| disable/enable `orders`, twice | unchanged after each enable | 2 |
| one `metadata:reloaded` with the artifact | `g_sales[accounts,orders,orders] g_service[cases,cases]` | 4 |
| the suite registered again through the `manifest` door | three copies of each | 6 |

So disable and enable do not re-fold anything. What doubles every module's entries is a re-registration of the package bodies: `ObjectQLPlugin.refreshReloadedPackages` re-registers every package of the artifact on `metadata:reloaded` (fired by the `os dev` artifact watcher and the HMR reload POST), and the manifest step of `ObjectQL.registerApp` called `registerAppNavContribution`, which only appends. A restart starts from one copy again. HotCRM's measurement most likely saw a reload land between the disable and the enable.

**The fix: derive, don't append.**

- `SchemaRegistry.setPackageNavContributions(packageId, contributions)` (new) makes the given list the package's whole set of contributions, in every app. It replaces in place: an app's list keeps the package's entries where the first registration put them, so ties in the fold (equal priority, the common case at the default 200) resolve in fresh-boot order. An app the package newly targets gets them at the end; an app it no longer names loses them.
- `ObjectQL.registerApp` calls it for every body with an id, with an empty list when the body declares none, so a body that dropped its contributions clears them. A body with no id keeps the old additive call.
- `uninstallPackage` clears the package's contributions. Before, an uninstalled package's entries stayed in the app: with no package row left, the fold's disabled check could not withhold them.
- `registerAppNavContribution` is unchanged (additive, one contribution at a time).
- The registry test double (`registry-module-mock.ts`) answers the new member.

The fold itself (`applyNavContributions`) is untouched, and so are `enablePackage` / `disablePackage` and the `onPackageEnabled` announcement (#30377): no dedupe by label or path after the fact.

## Tests

New top-level describes in the existing harness files.

`packages/objectql/src/registry-nav-contributions.test.ts`, through `ObjectQL.registerApp` (app + two contributing modules + one module with none, equal priorities), each compared with a fresh registration's snapshot taken in the same test:
- every body registered twice more (two reloads): fresh order, 4 contributions;
- one module registered twice more: its entries stay in place;
- two disable/enable cycles of a module, each with a reload: disabled hides only that module's entries, enabled again equals fresh; the `onPackageEnabled` listener hears the module exactly once per enable;
- a module with no contributions disabled, re-registered and enabled: navigation unchanged;
- a re-registered body that changed its contributions: the dropped entry leaves, the new one appears once; a body with none clears them;
- uninstalling a module (not disabling it) drops its contributions.

`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-disable-app-module.test.ts`, through the real doors: two cycles of `PATCH …/disable`, `metadata:reloaded` with the artifact, `PATCH …/enable`, then the suite registered again through the `manifest` service; the served `GET /meta/app/qs_app` group equals the fresh boot's after each step.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per negative pin, objectql rebuilt each leg, marker proved in dist/)</summary>

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs objectql ABLATION_30581` green before the run, restored to the HEAD blob afterwards.

1. `engine.ts`: the body path back to the additive call. objectql: 4 failed (two reloads, one module re-registered, disable/enable with reload, changed body); runtime: the #30581 case failed, `enabled again #1: expected [ 'nav_accounts', 'nav_orders', …(1) ] to deeply equal [ 'nav_accounts', 'nav_orders' ]`.
2. `registry.ts`: replace at the end instead of in place. objectql: 2 failed (one module re-registered, changed body); runtime stays green (one contributor there).
3. `registry.ts`: the uninstall clear removed. objectql: 1 failed (uninstall).

Restore leg: objectql rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs objectql ABLATION_30581 --absent` green, working tree clean against HEAD.
</details>

## Verification

All on the final head `0be4e9a0b` (branch merged with `origin/main` 14c67d446), dogfood closure rebuilt first.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 555 passed (555), Tests 11057 passed (11057); `typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 544 passed (544), Tests 8702 passed, 19 skipped (8721); `typecheck` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The card reads "re-enable re-folds the contributions". Measured, it does not: the enable and disable doors only flip the row, and the fold already asks the row on every read (#28117). The duplicate is the reload's re-registration, which this PR makes idempotent. The card's ask, "each entry appears exactly once after any number of disable and enable cycles", holds with or without reloads in between, and is pinned with two cycles.
- `registerAppNavContribution` keeps appending. Today only tests call it; a plugin that calls it from code twice still gets two copies, as before.
